:::{#exm-dist-mle-poisson}
#### Approximate distribution of the Poisson MLE

For $\dsn{X} \siid \Pois(\rate)$,
setting the score $\sumin X_i/\rate - n$ (@exm-information-equality)
to zero gives $\hat\rate_{\text{ML}} = \bar X$,
and $\einf(\rate) = n/\rate$ (@exm-information-poisson),
so @thm-dist-mle says that for large $n$:

$$\hat\rate_{\text{ML}} \dsim \ndist{\rate, \frac{\rate}{n}}$$

In this example the mean and variance are exact:
$\E{\bar X} = \rate$ and $\Var{\bar X} = \rate/n$.
The approximation is in the Gaussian shape.
:::
